newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia BNI shares soar in grey market.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia BNI shares soar in grey market.

text.p: Brokers said on Tuesday shares of PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) had risen about 16 percent in the so-called grey market ahead of its listing on November 25.
They said BNI shares in the grey market were traded at a premium of 125 to 150 rupiah to the initial public offering price of 850 rupiah a share.
The bank started its four-day offer of 1.085 billion shares on Monday. The shares will be listed on the Jakarta and Surabaya exchanges.
"We got order from some investors who wants to buy at least one million shares of BNI at a price of 1,000 rupiah," a broker from a major local brokerage firm said.
One foreign broker said his firm had received a bid of 975 rupiah from offshore buyers on Tuesday.
"But we cannot sell it because many investors still want to keep it until the listing date," he said.
The lead underwriter official said the stock has been seven times oversubscribed from local and foreign investors.
